summary: BigInt.asIntN first applies ToIndex(bits), then ToBigInt(value), then wraps modulo 2^bits into the signed range.

target.notes: Reuse canonical ToIndex and ToBigInt implementations; preserve their exception types and coercion ordering.

tests.name: bits coercion precedes value coercion
tests.input: const log=[]; const b={valueOf(){log.push("bits");return 8}}; const v={valueOf(){log.push("value");return 1n}}; BigInt.asIntN(b,v); console.log(log.join(","));
